text: No, the property has not experienced detectable tree-cover loss since 2021. Satellite data (Hansen GFC and JRC GFC2020) show no loss events of 0.5 hectares or larger between 2021 and 2025. While minor changes (under 0.5 ha) or narrow losses might have occurred and gone undetected due to the 30-meter pixel resolution, no significant deforestation was observed. The property had negligible forest cover in 2020 (0 ha per JRC data), and prior losses (e.g., 67.7 ha in 2020) all occurred before the baseline. Observations remain valid through 2025.
